name: Sublet finder
summary: A swipe stack of sublet posts filtered by budget and friends of friends, with a shortlist the chat shares.
useWhen: a housing group with many sublet or room posts
'looking for a summer sublet', 'anyone subletting near BART'
dontUseWhen: finding a roommate rather than a place (use roommate-match)
splitting rent for a place you have

posts.description: Sublet posts in the group, e.g. 1083

swiped.description: Members of the wider group who swiped today, e.g. 38

budgets.description: 3 monthly budget caps in cents, e.g. [120000, 160000, 220000]

listings.description: Up to 9 posts: hood, city, priceCents, dates, perk, via, viaWho, mutuals, view 0-4, x and y on the Bay map (0-1)

people.description: Chat members' saves and passes so far, by name and hood

labels.description: Up to 4 place names on the map: name, x and y (0-1), e.g. the town's neighbourhoods
